title: General characterization of parallel random-walk cover time

import_provenance.original_title: A general characterization of parallel random-walk cover time
import_provenance.original_statement: For any connected undirected graph G and k independent lazy random walks with worst-case starting vertices, characterize within constant factors the expected time until their union has visited every vertex. The challenge is a graph-general analogue of single-walk cover-time theory, including the speedup as k varies.
